report:
Breast, left, total mastectomy

The specimen consists of a left total mastectomy specimen (520 g, 190 x 160 x 45 mm) with an overlying skin ellipse (170 x 60 mm) bearing the nipple. Sectioning shows an ill-defined fibrotic area at the tumour bed; no residual tumour is identified grossly. The skin and nipple are unremarkable. A fibrotic tumour bed measuring 30 x 25 x 20 mm with a clip is present in the upper outer quadrant. Three lymph nodes are identified in the sentinel node specimen.

(1-6) tumour bed.
(7) nipple.
(8-11) margins.
(12-14) background breast.
(15-16) sentinel lymph nodes (3 nodes).

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Total mastectomy
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Upper outer quadrant (2 o'clock, 30 mm from the nipple)
- Tumour size: No residual carcinoma

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: No residual invasive carcinoma
- Tumour focality: Not applicable (no residual invasive carcinoma)
- Histologic grade: Not applicable (no residual invasive carcinoma)
- Tumour histology:
  Sections from the tumour bed show fibrosis, elastosis and histiocytic aggregates in keeping with treated tumour, with no residual invasive carcinoma. Ductal carcinoma in situ of high nuclear grade, solid type, with comedo necrosis, is present (4 mm). There is no lymphovascular invasion. The nipple and skin are not involved.
- Tumour extension: Confined to the breast parenchyma
  - Nipple: Present and not involved
  - Skin: Present and not involved
  - Skin satellite foci: Not identified
  - Skeletal muscle: Not present in specimen
- Lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Dermal lymphatic and/or vascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Breast treatment effect: No residual invasive carcinoma is present in the
  breast after presurgical therapy
- LN treatment effect: No lymph node metastases and no fibrous scarring or
  histiocytic aggregates in the nodes
- Grading of treatment effects (Miller and Payne): Grade 5
- Ductal carcinoma in situ: Present, Only DCIS is present after presurgical
  (neoadjuvant) therapy
  - Size (extent) of DCIS: 4 mm
  - Number of blocks with DCIS: 1 of 14 blocks examined
  - Nuclear grade: Grade III (high)
  - Necrosis: Present, central (expansive "comedo" necrosis)
  - Architectural patterns: Solid
- Additional lesions: Not identified
- Microcalcifications: Present in non-neoplastic tissue

Ancillary studies
- Biomarker studies: Reported on the prior core biopsy (S26-00456): ER negative,
  PR negative, HER2 positive (score 3+)
